primary_question.question: Why is my Arachuvitta Sambar too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not use high heat, because the dals and chilli can burn quickly

related_questions.question: Why does my Arachuvitta Sambar taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not roast fenugreek for long, or the sambar may taste bitter

related_questions.question: Why does my Arachuvitta Sambar stick or tear?
evidence: Do not make drumstick pieces too large, or they will cook slowly

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Arachuvitta Sambar?
evidence: Do not boil so hard that the liquid reduces too much

related_questions.question: Why is my Arachuvitta Sambar turning out soggy?
evidence: Do not cook on very high heat after adding brinjal, because it can turn mushy
